setup.title: Before you start
setup.rule: Askapeer works because nobody knows who anyone is. Every member here is a verified, registered practitioner — but no one can tell whether you're a consultant of thirty years or six months out of your degree. That is the point: ideas are judged on merit, not rank.
setup.ruleConsequence: Any attempt to identify yourself or another member — in a post, a reply, or by arranging it off the platform — results in immediate and permanent removal from Askapeer. There are no exceptions and no appeals.

welcome.title: Welcome to Askapeer
welcome.intro: Askapeer is a private network for registered sports medicine practitioners. Everyone here is verified, and everyone is anonymous to each other — so a question or an idea is judged on its merit, not on who asked it. This guide takes about five minutes.
welcome.pilot: You have been invited to the pilot. Registration is by invitation only, so please use the email address your invitation was sent to.
welcome.step1Body: Tap Register and fill in your name as it appears on your professional register, your email, your professional body and your registration number.
welcome.step1Reassure: Your name and registration number are used only to confirm you are registered. They are never shown to other members.
welcome.step2Title: Sign in with the six-digit code
welcome.step2Body: We email you a sign-in link and a six-digit code. Enter the code on the screen that asked for it. The code lasts 15 minutes, and only the most recent one works — so if you ask for another, use the new one.
welcome.step2Junk: Nothing arrived after a couple of minutes? Check your junk or quarantine folder, and look for mail from no-reply@mail.askapeer.co.uk. Work email systems sometimes hold mail from new senders. If it is not there, reply to your invitation and we will sort it out.
welcome.step3Body: Your handle is the only name anyone will ever see. Pick something that says nothing about who you are or where you work. It is permanent, because your Insightful and Useful awards and your posts belong to it.
welcome.step3Rule: Askapeer works because nobody knows who anyone is. Any attempt to identify yourself or another member — in a post, a reply, or by arranging it off the platform — results in immediate and permanent removal. There are no exceptions and no appeals.
welcome.step4Title: Put Askapeer on your home screen
welcome.step4Body: Askapeer runs in your browser, and you can add it to your home screen so it opens like an app. There is nothing to download from an app store.
welcome.iphone2: Tap the Share button — the square with an arrow pointing up.
welcome.iphone3: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.
welcome.iphone4: Open Askapeer from your home screen and sign in there, using the six-digit code. A link opened from your email signs you in to Safari instead, which the home-screen app cannot see.
welcome.android2: Tap the menu — the three dots in the top corner.
welcome.android3: Tap Install app or Add to home screen, then confirm.
welcome.computer1: Askapeer works in any up-to-date browser. Bookmark it — there is nothing to install.
welcome.step5Body: Five tabs along the bottom take you everywhere.
welcome.navDiscussions: Discussions — questions and case discussions from other members. Open one to read the answers and add your own.
welcome.navAsk: Ask — the red button in the middle. Post a question, or a de-identified case discussion. A case cannot be published until you have completed the de-identification checklist.
welcome.navResearch: Research — recent sports medicine and physiotherapy papers. Set a keyword, the type of paper and how far back to look, and save anything you want to come back to.
welcome.navActivity: Activity — replies to your posts, the Insightful and Useful awards you have received, and discussions you follow.
welcome.navProfile: Profile — your handle, your Insightful and Useful totals, and your settings.
welcome.kudos: When a question or an answer helps you, recognise it with one or both of two awards: Insightful (the book) when it changes how you think, and Useful (the lightbulb) when it helps you in practice. Answers are ranked by the two together, so the most valuable rise to the top. The grey numbers beside a handle are that member's own totals.
welcome.searchTip: The magnifying glass at the top searches both discussions and research papers at once.
welcome.step6Body: This is a pilot, and your feedback shapes what happens next. If something is confusing, broken or missing, reply to your invitation email and tell us.
welcome.shotThread: A discussion: award Insightful or Useful, and follow it
welcome.footer: Askapeer — The No Ego Sports Medicine Network
